candidate_generation_config.selection_anchor: The original 89-row declaration-date candidate was rejected outcome-blind. candidate_generation_config.selection_policy: Generate exactly one candidate. Treat the complete SEC disclosure bundle as the event; do not claim dividend-only causality, remove coannouncements after outcome access, or select a winning confound subtype.

candidate_snapshots.hypothesis: Buying an active common stock at the first regular-session open strictly after both declaration-date close and an SEC filing that publicly confirms a recurring cash-dividend initiation or resumption following at least 1095 days without a same-ticker positive USD declaration can produce positive after-cost H10 replacement value versus the available cash-feasible core slot or cash, because accepting a recurring distribution commitment can reveal that cash-flow durability and capital-allocation policy crossed a state boundary not represented by the fixed core candidate pool. The treatment is the complete public filing bundle, not a claim that the dividend alone caused the response.

provenance.baseline_policy: use one actual same-entry-date cash-feasible core slot at most once; unmatched treatment slots use cash

independent_evidence.decision_exclusions: filings without explicit lifecycle language, amount mismatches, special/irregular/unknown distributions and mixed ticker-date distribution types
current identity remapping and future descriptive fields

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The core-or-cash prior represents the opportunity cost. A public SEC filing that explicitly starts or resumes a recurring cash distribution after a long observed gap is independent evidence of a capital-return state change outside the core roster.

transmission.catalyst: The complete SEC disclosure bundle explicitly confirms initiation or resumption of a recurring cash-dividend program.
transmission.expected_direction: The frozen 19-row bundle roster should exceed the identical costed value of the displaced core slot or cash.
transmission.half_life: First regular-session open after both SEC accepted_at and declaration-date close through the tenth trading-session close.

candidate_snapshots.why_not_arbitraged: Recurring-distribution state changes are sparse, often arrive inside broader corporate updates, and require point-in-time document interpretation plus a strict opportunity-cost hurdle. The bundle may be fully priced at the first tradable open, so the hypothesis can easily fail.
candidate_snapshots.falsifier: Reject unless the frozen roster remains exactly 5/5/9 across old_thin/mid_weak/late_strong, every entry open follows both SEC accepted_at and declaration-date close, at least two of three windows and the aggregate have positive after-cost replacement value versus the nonduplicated core-or-cash allocation, aggregate replacement value remains positive under double costs, maximum single-ticker positive contribution is at most 40%, top-five positive contribution share is at most 65%, and contribution HHI is at most 0.25. Report lifecycle and predeclared coannouncement signatures without selecting a winning subtype. If the aggregate result is explained only by one coannouncement signature, or a declaration/type/amount was not actually available as represented, reject rather than retune.

treatment.policy: Start from the outcome-blind endpoint-ready roster; require a pure recurring positive-USD distribution with frequency greater than zero, an SEC filing within seven calendar days whose text explicitly says initiation or resumption and contains the same per-share amount, and a valid first session open strictly after both SEC accepted_at and declaration-date New York close. Keep all 19 timestamp-verified filing bundles, predeclare their coannouncement signatures, enter at the decision-safe session open, exit at the tenth session close, use fixed $4,000 research notional and report double-cost stress. No post-entry price or return was used to select rows.

candidate_snapshots.replacement_value_comparator: Use one actual same-entry-date cash-feasible core slot at most once when present and not the same ticker; use zero-return cash for unmatched slots. SPY and QQQ remain secondary comparators.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: Fixed $4,000 research notional per row, no production allocation and no duplicated core comparator slot.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Apply repository round-trip costs and a predeclared double-cost stress; do not count a later dividend cash receipt.
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: Cash equities exactly as identified in the dated event roster; no ETF, option, leverage or present-day identity remapping.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: The inherited outcome-blind endpoint preflight requires 20 pre-declaration bars, median dollar volume of at least $1 million and reference close of at least $3.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Entry is the first New York regular-session open strictly after both SEC accepted_at and declaration-date close; exit is the tenth session close.
